description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03, northstar-classification audited PASS). CLASSIFICATION: A — LEGITIMATE SANCTIONED EXCEPTION (documented, not a push to convert). build_macro_executable (jobs/macro_runtime.rs) synchronously drives a nested BuildBackendProduct via world.complete_job to build+run the macro at compile time for its expanded source. This is northstar-consistent (an ignition of a bounded inner compilation unit, like submit_root), NOT a smuggled push, PROVEN independently by the audit: (1) FactKey::BackendProgram is co-output-only with no demand_fact_producer arm, and an arm is NOT mechanically addable (unlike family-8's EntryDispatch/etc.) because BuildBackendProduct's conclusion sets NO reads — its dependency provenance lives in PullSession's product-scoped bookkeeping, not the ordinary JobEffects.reads/work_graph.rebased protocol that arms need for incremental correctness; wiring an arm would silently disconnect BackendProgram from real invalidation. So wait_on_current(BackendProgram) would name a fact nothing can be demanded to produce = permanent stall. (2) BackendProgram is the settled result of a bounded multi-step product-pull fixpoint (drive_root_backend_product, 50k-job budget) — structurally un-waitable, not merely unwired. (3) The nested drive targets a FRESH distinct RootId (world.macro_root, the macro's own hidden compile-time root) — self-contained, never reaches the outer compilation. (4) jobs/native.rs::lower_native_program does the byte-identical pattern for its own root's NativeProgram — an established idiom. Job::BuildBackendProduct is never enqueued in production (only tests). DOCUMENTED: a comment at build_macro_executable + a fact-engine.md paragraph naming BackendProgram(root) via BuildMacroExecutable AND LowerNativeProgram as the second sanctioned non-wait work-start alongside submit_root's SeedRoot ignition. Comment+doc only, no behavior change. This is the northstar arc's boundary: submit_root ignition + bounded inner product-pulls are the two sanctioned non-wait work-starts; everything else is pull. Minor non-blocking asymmetry noted: native.rs is covered in fact-engine.md but got no local code comment (out of this ticket's owned files; the canonical doc covers it).
title: build_macro_executable synchronously completes BuildBackendProduct inline (non-follow_up push)
